source.title: RJME Guide for Authors
source.locator: 3.2 Abstract and Keywords: “A concise abstract of no more 250 words is required.”

rows.notes: “A concise abstract of no more 250 words is required.”

rows.statement: The unstructured abstract briefly states the purpose, main results and major conclusions.
rows.notes: “state briefly the purpose of the research, the main results and major conclusions.”

rows.statement: References are numbered in square brackets; list all authors and include DOI, PMID and PMCID.
rows.notes: “References (indicated by numbers in square brackets)… DOI, PMID and PMCID numbers are mandatory.”

rows.statement: The abstract body limit is 1810 characters, including spaces.

source.title: ERS Frequently Asked Questions About Abstracts

rows.notes: “The maximum length of an abstract is 1810 characters, including characters and spaces.”

rows.statement: The 1810-character allowance includes the abstract body, table and figures; each table cell adds one character and each inserted figure deducts 277 characters; the title is separate and limited to 250 characters.

source.title: ERS Frequently Asked Questions About Abstracts

rows.notes: “1810 characters… abstract body, table, and figures”; “title… separate… limited to 250”; figure “deducts 277 characters.”

rows.statement: The abstract body limit is 300 words per language; the English half is limited to 300 words.

source.title: Congres SRP: Rezumate
source.locator: Caracteristici tehnice de redactare a rezumatelor

rows.notes: “corpul rezumatului nu trebuie să depășească 300 de cuvinte pentru fiecare limbă”
